+function milestoneState(d){
+ if(!d)return {label:'Dates not locked',cls:''};
+ const now=new Date(), diff=Math.ceil((d-now)/(86400000));
+ if(diff<0)return {label:'Booking window open',cls:'open'};
+ if(diff===0)return {label:'Today',cls:'open'};
+ if(diff<=14)return {label:`${diff} day${diff===1?'':'s'} away`,cls:'soon'};
+ return {label:`${diff} days away`,cls:''};
